page_title: HAV 1-0 MNT | Le Havre v Montpellier 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Arthur Desmas has no trouble gathering it.
90+5' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) has come on for Modibo Sagnan.
86' The ball rebounds out to Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
86' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) will deliver the corner kick.
86' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
83' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
82' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
81' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Oussama Targhalline is replaced by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
80' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
78' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Birama Toure (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch for Rabby Nzingoula.
74' Here's the change. Enzo Tchato leaves the pitch and Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
73' 1 - 0 Goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Benjamin Lecomte.
73' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
72' It’s a PENALTY to Le Havre after the VAR review!

71' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
70' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
70' The free kick is delivered by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
70' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
68' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Rassoul Ndiaye and he is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
65' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
60' The substitution is prepared. Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Akor Adams.
59' The game is interrupted now, Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
56' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas was alert and made a comfortable save.
55' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
53' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
52' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Benjamin Lecomte.
51' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' What was Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
42' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is adjudged offside.
39' Foul! Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
39' A rebound spins to Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
37' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
37' Loic Nego (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
35' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
35' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
35' The resulting corner from Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
34' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
31' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
30' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) prepares to take a corner kick.

29' He should have scored! Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Benjamin Lecomte makes an easy save.
28' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
26' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
25' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
24' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
23' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

22' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Stephanie Frappart blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
20' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
19' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
18' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play.
17' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
15' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
12' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
11' Akor Adams (Montpellier) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
9' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
2' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stephanie Frappart.
